column1: Haikai Poet Yosa Buson And The Bashō Revival|2007|10|0|1784|8.5,6.5,4.5,6,7,9,2.5,9,6.5,7.5|Cheryl A. Crowley|Historical literary analysis, not a poetry-writing curriculum. https://catalogue.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/cb41029050r confirms 2007, 308 pages and bibliography 292–300; source's 2006 is corrected. Source 259 details tensions between patronage income, amateur ideals and commercial literary lineages, giving transferable institutional payload. D=7 moderate reader-report estimate: economic constraints and comparisons of forms add learning; detailed close readings narrow the yield. T11 Japanese cultural history, T12=0 art central. Approximate main endpoint 1784 (Buson's death by Gregorian dating), low confidence; later reception epilogue does not reset it.

Chased by the Light|1998|10|0||7.5,2.5,3,2.5,4,8.5,1.5,9,8,8|Jim Brandenburg|Counterfactual V3: photographic nature diary with reflective essay, not a technical photography manual. https://catalog.libraries.vsc.edu/cgi-bin/koha/opac-detail.pl?biblionumber=420851 and source 259 identify 90 photographs, one per day, and 1998 original. The constraint is a reusable creative heuristic, but the bulk remains visual contemplation rather than explanatory learning; V3 moderate, not zero artistic value. D=4 low confidence from catalog/source: varied natural observations, little mechanism. T11 nature/environment predominance; H13=0 not an argument about a historical period.

100 Suns|2003|10|10|1962|8,4,3.5,3,4.5,9,6,8.5,7.5,7.5|Michael Light|Counterfactual V3: photographic record of US atmospheric nuclear tests, not physics training. Author https://www.michaellight.net/publications confirms 2003 and 208 pages; https://books.google.com/books/about/100_Suns.html?id=K_oSii4elZ0C identifies 1945–1962. Author interview https://lightresearch.net/light/100-suns-and-the-nuclear-sublime-an-interview-with-michael-light/ makes aesthetic confrontation central. D=4.5 low-confidence description/source estimate: visual scale and test conditions add observations, little sustained causal explanation. T11 American-focused record and T12 military tests, endpoint 1962. V3 moderate despite strong documentary value.

Tokyo: A Certain Style|1993|10|0||8,4.5,4.5,3.5,6,8,4,8,7.5,7|Kyoichi Tsuzuki|Retain with low eligibility confidence: photographs and captions provide concrete examples of space allocation, storage and adaptation to costly small housing, beyond personalities alone. No technical training purpose. https://cca-islands.org/archives/prof_lec/tsuzuki/?lang=en establishes original Tokyo Style 1993; English 1999 edition https://books.google.com/books?id=Pvj7AZUZ1YYC has 440 pages. D=6 low-confidence description estimate: contrasting room constraints add useful cases, many decorative particulars offer less. T11 urban/single-city focus; T12=0. H13=0 contemporary observational study, not a historical-period argument.

The Mask of Sanity|1941|10|0||5.5,5.5,4.5,4.5,6,7,3,8.5,7,6.5|Hervey M. Cleckley|Retain with moderate eligibility confidence: a discursive clinical investigation and problem exposition for professional and general readers, not a treatment/procedure curriculum. Contemporary review https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jama/article-abstract/297998 and prefaces https://gwern.net/doc/psychology/personality/psychopathy/1941-cleckley-maskofsanity.pdf establish this purpose and original 1941. Interpret as historical observational evidence, not current diagnostic authority. E=5.5 for selected cases and moralized categories; source 259 documents these limits. D=6 moderate reader-report estimate: institutional/legal dilemmas add learning, repeated clinical stories and moralizing lower yield. T11 disease; H13=0 general clinical argument, not publication year as topic endpoint.

Confessions of an English Opium Eater|1821|10|0||6,4,4,3.5,5.5,8.5,2,8,8,8.5|Thomas De Quincey|Retain as nonfiction memoir: dependence, incentive reversal and unreliable self-justification provide modest transferable observations without treating speculation as neuroscience. Source 259 describes its full first-version reading and limits; https://ebooks.inflibnet.ac.in/engp03/chapter/thomas-de-quincey/ confirms original 1821 serial, 1822 collected book. D=5.5 moderate reader-report estimate: dependence contrasts add learning; digressions and dream material lower explanatory yield. T11 addiction/disease, T12=0. Approximate personal chronology is not substituted for a clear central historic period; H13=0.

The Doors of Perception|1954|0|10||4,4.5,3,3,6,7,3,7,8,7|Aldous Huxley|Counterfactual V1, moderate confidence: representative text https://huxleyarchive.org/Non-fiction/BOOKS/The%20Doors%20of%20Perception.pdf moves from subjective mescaline experience to a brain-filter/Mind-at-Large explanation involving universal awareness without evidence that the experience distinguishes that model. The problem is this central inference, not the report that perceptions changed. Original 1954, cached OL64441W. D=6 low-confidence sample estimate: perceptual/artistic distinctions add learning, repeated metaphysical interpretation less. T12 philosophy; T11=0 an experience essay rather than predominantly disease. H13=0.

Suspiria De Profundis|1845|0|0||5.5,2.5,2.5,2,4.5,8,1,8,6.5,8|Thomas De Quincey|Counterfactual V3: autobiographical prose-poem essays and dream reflection, rather than an ordinary fictional plot. https://ebooks.inflibnet.ac.in/engp03/chapter/thomas-de-quincey/ confirms 1845 original and incomplete publication. Source 259 quotes childhood grief material. D=4.5 low-confidence sample/description estimate: memory and suffering distinctions add some learning, visionary passages offer little causal explanation. No sufficiently predominant disease or philosophy theme established for extra deductions. H13=0 reflective work; revised reprints do not reset original age.

Seeds in the Heart|1993|10|0|1600|9,6.5,5,6,8,9.5,2.5,9.5,7,8|Donald Keene|Eligible historical literary survey, not a specialist proficiency curriculum. https://openlibrary.org/books/OL1393888M/Seeds_in_the_heart verifies 1993, 1265 pages and coverage to 1600. Source 259 identifies substantive explanation of early poetry and social context. D=8 low confidence from partial reader evidence/description: distinct genres, institutions and periods promise substantial learning; whole-book paragraph density is unverified, not inferred from prestige. T11 Japanese history, T12=0 literature central. Endpoint 1600.

Double Entry|2011|0|10||6.5,7.5,6.5,6.5,6.5,8.5,6.5,7,8,7|Jane Gleeson-White|Historical explanation of bookkeeping and commerce, not an accounting methods manual. Original 2011 verified by cached OL16654832W, not source's 2012 edition. Detailed source 259 review documents useful Pacioli/Venetian context but questions causal claims and moralized modern extensions. D=6.5 moderate reader-report confidence: commercial institutions and diffusion add knowledge, broad scandal framing and repetition yield less. E discounts treating bookkeeping as a sufficient cause of capitalism. T12 finance central; T11=0 ecology appears as an extension, not established predominance. H13=0 broad cross-period history.

The Riddle of the Labyrinth|2013|0|0|1956|7.5,6,7.5,7.5,7.5,9,7,8.5,8,8|Margalit Fox|Discovery narrative of Linear B decipherment, not language training. https://www.publishersweekly.com/9780062228833 verifies 2013 and describes Kober's systematic card work and Ventris's decoding; source 259 questions the stronger counterfactual allocation of credit. E discounts hero-revisionism without discarding explanatory work. D=7.5 moderate corroborated-review confidence: symbol constraints and comparisons of approaches add learning, personal material sometimes contributes less. Endpoint 1956, approximate end of central decipherer narrative; not the Bronze Age of the tablets. T11/T12=0, intellectual discovery rather than single-nation history.

Empires of the Plains|2003|0|0|1895|8,6.5,6.5,6.5,7,9,6,8,8,7.5|Lesley Adkins|Source's pluralized wording identifies Empires of the Plain: Henry Rawlinson and the Lost Languages of Babylon. https://search.worldcat.org/title/52145740 verifies 2003, author and cuneiform decipherment narrative. Retain discovery/access/rivalry mechanisms, not a philological curriculum. D=7 low-confidence catalog/source estimate: inscription access, comparative evidence and decipherment constraints add learning; adventure biography adds lower-yield passages. T11/T12=0 scholarly discovery spans several regions. Endpoint 1895, approximate biographical boundary rather than date of ancient inscriptions, low confidence.

Japanese Love Hotels|2007|10|0||7,6,5,5.5,5.5,8,3.5,8.5,5.5,6|Sarah Chaplin|Nontechnical architectural/social history, eligible despite poor fit. Cached OL8102897W verifies 2007. Source 259 gives detailed reading report: a large establishment survey, spatial privacy, changing service conventions, but extensive theoretical framing and underused quantitative material. D=5.5 moderate reader-report confidence: design constraints and commercial adaptation add learning; abstract discussion and repetition lower yield. E=7, no demonstrated serious veto-level failure. T11 urban/Japanese social history; H13=0 broad historical-to-contemporary account without one central closed period.

The Life of Samuel Johnson|1791|0|10|1784|7.5,4.5,5,4,3.5,9,2,8.5,5.5,8|James Boswell|Retain with low confidence: conversations contain reusable judgments about argument, reputation, work and human conduct, though extensive personal detail gives very poor density. Original 1791 verified by Royal Collection https://www.rct.uk/collection/stories/the-libraries-of-george-iii/the-life-of-samuel-johnson-comprehending-an-account-of-his-studies-and-numerous-works-in . Its description misdates Johnson's death; endpoint 1784 follows established biography, not that isolated error. Source 259 read the long Hill edition and identifies digression and anecdotes. D=3.5 moderate reader-report confidence, not an assumption that length alone is padding. T12 moral/literary philosophy; T11=0 author is not a media celebrity merely by fame.

The Rambler|1750|0|10||7,4.5,5.5,5,6.5,9,2,8.5,7,8.5|Samuel Johnson|Nonfiction moral and critical essays collected in book form, not merely a never-published website/periodical. Cached OL14862914W confirms serial production 1750–1752 and repeated book editions. Retain practical observations about judgment, vanity and habits; Christian background does not alone establish dominant doctrinal proselytism. D=6.5 low-confidence description estimate: varied situations and distinctions add learning, recurring moral rhetoric may yield less. T12 philosophy; T11/H13=0 general essays rather than history of 1750s.

An Introduction to Japanese Court Poetry|1968|10|0|1500|8.5,4.5,3.5,4.5,7,9,1.5,9,7,7.5|Earl Miner|Retain historical/aesthetic survey: source's textbook label does not make it a technical curriculum when independent explanation of poets and changing forms is the main value. https://ci.nii.ac.jp/ncid/BA09942955 verifies 1968 and 173 pages, based on but distinct from the longer 1961 work. Source 259 read it and reports useful poet profiles and somewhat wordy translations. D=7 moderate reader-report confidence: contrasting conventions add learning, compact treatment limits explanation. T11 Japanese literary history, approximate endpoint 1500 for medieval tradition, low confidence; T12=0.
